Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 1
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = xlPlaceholders
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\placeholders.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\placeholders.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 2
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = xlHide
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\hide.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\hide.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 3
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = xlHide
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = xlDisplayShapes
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\shapes.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\shapes.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 4
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = 0
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 5
        wb.DisplayDrawingObjects = "x"
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 6
        wb.DisplayInkComments = False
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ink.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\ink.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 7
        wb.RemovePersonalInformation = True
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\personal.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\personal.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 8
        wb.EnableAutoRecover = False
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\recover.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\recover.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 9
        wb.ReadOnlyRecommended = True
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\recommended.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\recommended.xlsx", IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
        Tried = Tried & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 10
        wb.ReadOnlyRecommended = "x"
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Case 11
        wb.EnableAutoRecover = Null
        Tried = wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description & " / " & wb.DisplayDrawingObjects & " " & wb.DisplayInkComments & " " & wb.RemovePersonalInformation & " " & wb.EnableAutoRecover & " " & wb.ReadOnlyRecommended & " " & wb.Saved
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 11
        s = s & "|" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
